brief:
Hamas accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of deliberately undermining ceasefire negotiations following a deadly Israeli attack on Gaza City, according to Middle East Eye. The movement issued a statement describing the strike as an effort to derail ongoing talks aimed at ending the conflict in the territory.

The accusation underscores deepening rifts between the parties as ceasefire discussions proceed amid mutual recriminations. Hamas characterized the attack as evidence of bad faith, while international mediators work to bridge gaps on key provisions including prisoner releases and reconstruction timelines. The incident comes as negotiators attempt to move toward a comprehensive agreement.
